Post for Medical Officer
Tuesday, 14 August 2018
5300 Hits
Secretary, Kasturba Health Society invites applications for the post of Medical Officer for Dr Sushila Nayar Hospital, Utavali, Melghat. Applications on plain paper along with complete bio-data with necessary experience certificates / testimonials must reach the office of the Secretary, Kasturba Health Society, Sevagram Dist. Wardha (MS) latest by
28/08/2018
.
Required Qualification and Experience: BAMS. Candidates with previous experience of working in Hospital, Out patient, Inpatient departments, M.J.F.J.A.Y. scheme and Community Health Services will be preferred.
Salary: Consolidated Salary of Rs. 25000/- per month. In addition free shared accommodation and Breakfast, Lunch, Evening Tea and Dinner.
Age Limit: 38 years. Age can be relaxed for exceptional/ experienced candidates
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
